paragraphs.hanzi: 街道旁有一栋旧楼，过去是图书馆，如今屋里的桌子坏了，书也摆放得很乱。附近的居民提出把它改成停车的地方，理由很简单：每天找地方停车实在太难。负责保管图书的老人没有立即反对。他顺着楼前的路走到学校，问孩子们放学后在哪里看书。有人说在家，有人说家里太吵，只好站在书店里读。老人把这些回答记在纸上，带回了会议室。
paragraphs.pinyin: Jiēdào páng yǒu yī dòng jiù lóu, guòqù shì túshūguǎn, rújīn wū lǐ de zhuōzi huài le, shū yě bǎifàng de hěn luàn. Fùjìn de jūmín tíchū bǎ tā gǎichéng tíngchē de dìfang, lǐyóu hěn jiǎndān: měitiān zhǎo dìfang tíngchē shízài tài nán. Fùzé bǎoguǎn túshū de lǎorén méiyǒu lìjí fǎnduì. Tā shùn zhe lóu qián de lù zǒu dào xuéxiào, wèn háizimen fàngxué hòu zài nǎlǐ kàn shū. Yǒu rén shuō zài jiā, yǒu rén shuō jiā lǐ tài chǎo, zhǐhǎo zhàn zài shūdiàn lǐ dú. Lǎorén bǎ zhèxiē huídá jì zài zhǐ shàng, dài huí le huìyìshì.
paragraphs.translation: Beside the road stands an old building that was once a library. Now the tables inside are broken, and the books are in complete disarray as well. Local residents propose turning it into a parking lot for a very simple reason: finding somewhere to park every day is far too difficult. The elderly man responsible for looking after the books does not immediately object. He follows the road in front of the building to the school and asks the children where they read after class. Some say at home; others say their homes are too noisy, so they have to make do with standing in a bookshop to read. The elderly man writes these answers on a sheet of paper and takes them to the meeting room.

paragraphs.hanzi: 会议上，一位年轻人提出，旧楼并非只能留下或拆掉，还可以改变内部的布局。他画了一张图，把入口附近的地方留给需要安静阅读的人，把后面的房间留给参加活动的孩子。居民们半信半疑：没有钱买新桌子，光有一张图又有什么用？年轻人没有争辩，而是请大家说说家中有什么不用的家具。一张餐桌、几把椅子和一盏灯，很快就有人愿意提供。老人亦答应整理藏书，给每一本书贴上编号。
paragraphs.pinyin: Huìyì shàng, yī wèi niánqīngrén tíchū, jiù lóu bìngfēi zhǐ néng liúxià huò chāidiào, hái kěyǐ gǎibiàn nèibù de bùjú. Tā huà le yī zhāng tú, bǎ rùkǒu fùjìn de dìfang liú gěi xūyào ānjìng yuèdú de rén, bǎ hòumiàn de fángjiān liú gěi cānjiā huódòng de háizi. Jūmínmen bànxìnbànyí: méiyǒu qián mǎi xīn zhuōzi, guāng yǒu yī zhāng tú yòu yǒu shénme yòng? Niánqīngrén méiyǒu zhēngbiàn, érshì qǐng dàjiā shuōshuo jiā zhōng yǒu shénme bù yòng de jiājù. Yī zhāng cānzhuō, jǐ bǎ yǐzi hé yī zhǎn dēng, hěn kuài jiù yǒu rén yuànyì tígōng. Lǎorén yì dāying zhěnglǐ cángshū, gěi měi yī běn shū tiē shàng biānhào.
paragraphs.translation: During the meeting, a young man points out that preserving or demolishing the old building are not the only options: its interior layout could also be changed. He draws a floor plan, setting aside the space near the entrance for those who need to read in peace and the rooms at the back for children taking part in activities. The residents are skeptical: without money to buy new tables, what use is a mere floor plan? The young man does not argue, but invites everyone to say what unused furniture they have at home. Before long, people offer a dining table, some chairs, and a lamp. The elderly man also promises to put the books in order and give each one a numbered label.

paragraphs.hanzi: 接下来的星期天，居民们一起来打扫房间。修桌子的人发现，真正需更换的部件没有想象的多；帮忙整理图书的孩子，也找到了自己爱看的故事。楼前只留下几处停车的地方，其余的空间种上了花。开门那天，没有人颁发奖牌，大家只是坐下来，各自读了一会儿书。年轻人说，这栋楼还不够漂亮，今后仍需有人保管，也会出现新的问题。老人点了点头，把门敞开：公共的地方有何价值，要看人们愿不愿意共同照顾它。
paragraphs.pinyin: Jiēxiàlái de xīngqītiān, jūmínmen yīqǐ lái dǎsǎo fángjiān. Xiū zhuōzi de rén fāxiàn, zhēnzhèng xū gēnghuàn de bùjiàn méiyǒu xiǎngxiàng de duō; bāngmáng zhěnglǐ túshū de háizi, yě zhǎodào le zìjǐ ài kàn de gùshi. Lóu qián zhǐ liúxià jǐ chù tíngchē de dìfang, qíyú de kōngjiān zhòng shàng le huā. Kāimén nà tiān, méiyǒu rén bānfā jiǎngpái, dàjiā zhǐshì zuò xiàlái, gèzì dú le yīhuìr shū. Niánqīngrén shuō, zhè dòng lóu hái bù gòu piàoliang, jīnhòu réng xū yǒu rén bǎoguǎn, yě huì chūxiàn xīn de wèntí. Lǎorén diǎn le diǎn tóu, bǎ mén chǎngkāi: gōnggòng de dìfang yǒu hé jiàzhí, yào kàn rénmen yuàn bù yuànyì gòngtóng zhàogu tā.
paragraphs.translation: The following Sunday, the residents come together to clean the rooms. Those repairing the tables discover that fewer parts need replacing than expected; the children helping to organize the books also find stories they love to read. Only a few parking spaces remain in front of the building, while flowers are planted in the rest of the area. On opening day, no one hands out medals: everyone simply sits down and reads for a while, each on their own. The young man says that the building is still not attractive enough, that it will continue to need someone to look after it, and that new problems will arise. The elderly man nods and opens the door wide: the value of a public place depends on people's willingness to care for it together.

paragraphs.hanzi: 我第一次走进那间制作瓷器的车间时，最感兴趣的不是陈列在门口的成品，而是门后一只形状不太规则的杯子。它的表面粗糙，颜色也有深有浅，看起来与周围的作品很不相同。师傅告诉我，那是他刚学制作瓷器时做的，一直没有丢弃。我以为他留着它，是为了提醒自己不要再犯同样的错误。他笑了，说这个解释只说对了一半。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ dì yī cì zǒu jìn nà jiān zhìzuò cíqì de chējiān shí, zuì gǎn xìngqù de bù shì chénliè zài ménkǒu de chéngpǐn, érshì mén hòu yī zhī xíngzhuàng bù tài guīzé de bēizi. Tā de biǎomiàn cūcāo, yánsè yě yǒu shēn yǒu qiǎn, kàn qǐlái yǔ zhōuwéi de zuòpǐn hěn bù xiāngtóng. Shīfu gàosu wǒ, nà shì tā gāng xué zhìzuò cíqì shí zuò de, yīzhí méiyǒu diūqì. Wǒ yǐwéi tā liú zhe tā, shì wèile tíxǐng zìjǐ bù yào zài fàn tóngyàng de cuòwù. Tā xiào le, shuō zhège jiěshì zhǐ shuō duì le yībàn.
paragraphs.translation: The first time I entered that pottery studio, what intrigued me most was not the finished pieces displayed at the entrance, but a rather irregularly shaped cup behind the door. Its surface was rough, and its color varied between dark and light shades: it looked very different from the pieces around it. The master told me he had made it when he had just begun learning pottery and had never thrown it away. I thought he kept it to remind himself not to make the same mistake again. He smiled and said that explanation was only half right.

paragraphs.hanzi: 在随后的学习中，我总想尽快做出一件可以出售的作品。只要杯子的边缘稍有变化，我就急着重新开始，桌子上留下许多没有完成的东西。师傅没有催促我，只叫我观察自己的手。他说，手上的力量忽大忽小，做出来的东西自然不稳。我不服气，连做带改地忙了一下午，最后却连最简单的形状都做不好。除此之外，我还因为使的力量太大，弄疼了手，只好停下来。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zài suíhòu de xuéxí zhōng, wǒ zǒng xiǎng jǐnkuài zuò chū yī jiàn kěyǐ chūshòu de zuòpǐn. Zhǐyào bēizi de biānyuán shāo yǒu biànhuà, wǒ jiù jí zhe chóngxīn kāishǐ, zhuōzi shàng liúxià xǔduō méiyǒu wánchéng de dōngxi. Shīfu méiyǒu cuīcù wǒ, zhǐ jiào wǒ guānchá zìjǐ de shǒu. Tā shuō, shǒu shàng de lìliang hū dà hū xiǎo, zuò chūlái de dōngxi zìrán bù wěn. Wǒ bù fúqì, lián zuò dài gǎi de máng le yī xiàwǔ, zuìhòu què lián zuì jiǎndān de xíngzhuàng dōu zuò bù hǎo. Chú cǐ zhī wài, wǒ hái yīnwèi shǐ de lìliang tài dà, nòng téng le shǒu, zhǐhǎo tíng xiàlái.
paragraphs.translation: As I continued learning, I always wanted to make something I could sell as quickly as possible. The slightest variation in a cup's rim would send me rushing to start again, leaving many unfinished objects on the table. The master did not rush me: he simply encouraged me to watch my hands. He said that if the pressure from my hands kept increasing and decreasing, it was only natural that the results would be inconsistent. Unwilling to concede his point, I spent the whole afternoon making things and correcting them, but in the end I could not even get the simplest shape right. What was more, I hurt my hand by using too much force and had to stop.

paragraphs.hanzi: 第二天，师傅让我把昨天留下的东西按制作的时间排好。我这才注意到，有几件并不是全坏了，只需改变一个地方。他让我一件一件地对照，讲清哪里应该保留，哪里确实出了毛病。原来，所谓练习，就是通过一次次具体的观察，辨别自己的选择是否得当，而不是不断地把全部工作推倒。那些似乎没有用的尝试，也能成为判断的依据。
paragraphs.pinyin: Dì èr tiān, shīfu ràng wǒ bǎ zuótiān liúxià de dōngxi àn zhìzuò de shíjiān pái hǎo. Wǒ zhè cái zhùyì dào, yǒu jǐ jiàn bìng bù shì quán huài le, zhǐ xū gǎibiàn yī ge dìfang. Tā ràng wǒ yī jiàn yī jiàn de duìzhào, jiǎng qīng nǎlǐ yīnggāi bǎoliú, nǎlǐ quèshí chū le máobìng. Yuánlái, suǒwèi liànxí, jiù shì tōngguò yī cì cì jùtǐ de guānchá, biànbié zìjǐ de xuǎnzé shìfǒu dédàng, ér bù shì bùduàn de bǎ quánbù gōngzuò tuīdǎo. Nàxiē sìhū méiyǒu yòng de chángshì, yě néng chéngwéi pànduàn de yījù.
paragraphs.translation: The next day, the master had me arrange the objects left over from the day before in the order I had made them. Only then did I notice that some were not completely ruined: just one part needed changing. He asked me to compare them one by one and explain clearly what should be kept and where there was a genuine flaw. I realized that practicing means making concrete observations again and again to determine whether one's choices are appropriate, rather than constantly tearing down all one's work. Even those seemingly useless attempts can become a basis for judgment.

paragraphs.hanzi: 一个月后，我终于完成了一只普通的杯子。它没有精美的图案，却拿得舒服，用起来也方便。我没有把它摆到入口，而是每天用它喝水。归根到底，学会制作瓷器，不只是为了获得别人的称赞，还要学会与不完美的过程相处。我也明白了，那只旧杯子留下来的，不只是一个错误，还是师傅愿意继续学习的开始。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yī ge yuè hòu, wǒ zhōngyú wánchéng le yī zhī pǔtōng de bēizi. Tā méiyǒu jīngměi de tú'àn, què ná de shūfu, yòng qǐlái yě fāngbiàn. Wǒ méiyǒu bǎ tā bǎi dào rùkǒu, érshì měitiān yòng tā hē shuǐ. Guīgēndàodǐ, xuéhuì zhìzuò cíqì, bù zhǐshì wèile huòdé biérén de chēngzàn, hái yào xuéhuì yǔ bù wánměi de guòchéng xiāngchǔ. Wǒ yě míngbai le, nà zhī jiù bēizi liú xiàlái de, bù zhǐshì yī ge cuòwù, hái shì shīfu yuànyì jìxù xuéxí de kāishǐ.
paragraphs.translation: A month later, I finally managed to finish an ordinary cup. It had no elaborate decorations, but it was comfortable to hold and practical to use. I did not put it at the entrance: I used it every day for drinking. After all, learning pottery is not just about earning other people's praise: one must also learn to live with an imperfect process. I also understood that the old cup preserved not just a mistake, but the beginning of the master's willingness to keep learning.

paragraphs.hanzi: 学校后面有一小块地，老师让我们试着种菜。第一次讨论时，大家的意见很不一致：有人主张多浇水，有人相信肥料越多，蔬菜就长得越快。另一个同学从网上找到一篇文章，说用厨房里的废物也能改良种菜的地。文章写得很有把握，我们却不知道其中的办法在这块地上是否管用。老师没有替我们作出选择，而是让各组提出一个能够比较的问题。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xuéxiào hòumiàn yǒu yī xiǎo kuài dì, lǎoshī ràng wǒmen shì zhe zhòng cài. Dì yī cì tǎolùn shí, dàjiā de yìjiàn hěn bù yīzhì: yǒu rén zhǔzhāng duō jiāo shuǐ, yǒu rén xiāngxìn féiliào yuè duō, shūcài jiù zhǎng de yuè kuài. Lìng yī ge tóngxué cóng wǎng shàng zhǎodào yī piān wénzhāng, shuō yòng chúfáng lǐ de fèiwù yě néng gǎiliáng zhòng cài de dì. Wénzhāng xiě de hěn yǒu bǎwò, wǒmen què bù zhīdào qízhōng de bànfǎ zài zhè kuài dì shàng shìfǒu guǎnyòng. Lǎoshī méiyǒu tì wǒmen zuòchū xuǎnzé, érshì ràng gè zǔ tíchū yī ge nénggòu bǐjiào de wèntí.
paragraphs.translation: There is a small plot behind the school, and our teacher invites us to try growing vegetables. In our first discussion, opinions vary widely: some argue that we need to water a lot, while others believe that the more fertilizer we use, the faster the vegetables will grow. Another classmate finds an article online saying that kitchen scraps can also improve garden soil. The article is written with great confidence, but we do not know whether the methods it describes will work on this plot. The teacher does not decide for us: instead, each group is asked to formulate a question that allows for a comparison.

paragraphs.hanzi: 我们以浇水的次数为观察的重点，把同样的种子种在几个大小相同的地方，尽量保持其他条件一致。起初，负责记录的同学觉得每天测量很麻烦，后来发现叶子的变化，才开始主动拍照。太阳很强的几天，一组的叶子明显变黄了。我们急着断定水太少，老师却提醒，叶子变黄可能有不同的根源，不能把一种现象直接当作一种解释的证明。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐ jiāo shuǐ de cìshù wéi guānchá de zhòngdiǎn, bǎ tóngyàng de zhǒngzi zhòng zài jǐ ge dàxiǎo xiāngtóng de dìfang, jǐnliàng bǎochí qítā tiáojiàn yīzhì. Qǐchū, fùzé jìlù de tóngxué juéde měitiān cèliáng hěn máfan, hòulái fāxiàn yèzi de biànhuà, cái kāishǐ zhǔdòng pāizhào. Tàiyáng hěn qiáng de jǐ tiān, yī zǔ de yèzi míngxiǎn biàn huáng le. Wǒmen jí zhe duàndìng shuǐ tài shǎo, lǎoshī què tíxǐng, yèzi biàn huáng kěnéng yǒu bù tóng de gēnyuán, bù néng bǎ yī zhǒng xiànxiàng zhíjiē dàngzuò yī zhǒng jiěshì de zhèngmíng.
paragraphs.translation: We focus our observations on watering frequency: we plant the same kind of seeds in several equally sized plots, trying to keep all other conditions identical. At first, the classmate responsible for keeping records finds taking measurements every day a nuisance; only after noticing changes in the leaves does he begin photographing them on his own initiative. During several days of strong sunshine, the leaves in one group become noticeably yellow. We hastily conclude that they are not getting enough water, but the teacher reminds us that yellowing can have different causes: an observed phenomenon cannot automatically be treated as proof of an explanation.

paragraphs.hanzi: 于是，大家一面检查地里的情况，一面重新阅读前几天的记录。我们发现，那一组除了浇水少，附近的树也被人修剪过，白天照到的阳光增加了。原先自认为公平的比较，其实没有考虑到一个条件。这让我们有些失望，却也促使我们反思：实验的价值不只在于得到想要的答案，也在于发现问题出在哪里。我们重新分组，并请其他同学检查记录的方法。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yúshì, dàjiā yīmiàn jiǎnchá dì lǐ de qíngkuàng, yīmiàn chóngxīn yuèdú qián jǐ tiān de jìlù. Wǒmen fāxiàn, nà yī zǔ chúle jiāo shuǐ shǎo, fùjìn de shù yě bèi rén xiūjiǎn guo, báitiān zhào dào de yángguāng zēngjiā le. Yuánxiān zì rènwéi gōngpíng de bǐjiào, qíshí méiyǒu kǎolǜ dào yī ge tiáojiàn. Zhè ràng wǒmen yǒuxiē shīwàng, què yě cùshǐ wǒmen fǎnsī: shíyàn de jiàzhí bù zhǐ zàiyú dédào xiǎng yào de dá'àn, yě zàiyú fāxiàn wèntí chū zài nǎlǐ. Wǒmen chóngxīn fēnzǔ, bìng qǐng qítā tóngxué jiǎnchá jìlù de fāngfǎ.
paragraphs.translation: So we check the soil conditions and, at the same time, reread our records from previous days. We discover that, besides receiving less water, that group was near trees that had been pruned, increasing the sunlight it received during the day. The comparison we thought was fair had actually failed to account for one condition. This disappoints us a little, but it also makes us reflect: the value of an experiment lies not only in obtaining the desired answer, but also in discovering where the problem is. We reorganize the groups and ask other classmates to check our recording method.

paragraphs.hanzi: 等到收获的时候，种出的菜并不多，桌子上却放着一叠厚厚的记录。我们把发现和不足一起写成报告，没有说已经找到了最好的种菜办法。老师说，因证据不够而暂时保留判断，并不是失败。带着问题认真观察，比急着反驳别人更接近研究。那天，我们吃着自己种的菜，觉得这次收获不只是盘子里的东西。
paragraphs.pinyin: Děng dào shōuhuò de shíhou, zhòng chū de cài bìng bù duō, zhuōzi shàng què fàng zhe yī dié hòuhòu de jìlù. Wǒmen bǎ fāxiàn hé bùzú yīqǐ xiě chéng bàogào, méiyǒu shuō yǐjīng zhǎodào le zuì hǎo de zhòng cài bànfǎ. Lǎoshī shuō, yīn zhèngjù bù gòu ér zànshí bǎoliú pànduàn, bìng bù shì shībài. Dài zhe wèntí rènzhēn guānchá, bǐ jí zhe fǎnbó biérén gèng jiējìn yánjiū. Nà tiān, wǒmen chī zhe zìjǐ zhòng de cài, juéde zhè cì shōuhuò bù zhǐshì pánzi lǐ de dōngxi.
paragraphs.translation: At harvest time, we have not grown many vegetables, but there is a thick stack of records on the table. We write a report that includes both our findings and our shortcomings, without claiming that we have already found the best growing method. The teacher says that temporarily withholding judgment because of insufficient evidence is not a failure. Making careful observations guided by a question is closer to research than rushing to refute others. That day, as we eat the vegetables we grew ourselves, we feel that the harvest consists of more than what is on our plates.

paragraphs.hanzi: 社区准备在节日举办一次合唱演出，邀请居民报名。通知刚贴出来，报名的人就超过了原来的计划。有人年轻时参加过歌舞演出，有人连简单的歌也唱不准，还有几位老人听力不太好，总要站得离老师近一些。第一次练习结束后，负责组织的同事有些焦虑：舞台不大，准备时间又短，大家的程度有这么大的差别，最后能唱好吗？
paragraphs.pinyin: Shèqū zhǔnbèi zài jiérì jǔbàn yī cì héchàng yǎnchū, yāoqǐng jūmín bàomíng. Tōngzhī gāng tiē chūlái, bàomíng de rén jiù chāoguò le yuánlái de jìhuà. Yǒu rén niánqīng shí cānjiā guo gēwǔ yǎnchū, yǒu rén lián jiǎndān de gē yě chàng bù zhǔn, hái yǒu jǐ wèi lǎorén tīnglì bù tài hǎo, zǒng yào zhàn de lí lǎoshī jìn yīxiē. Dì yī cì liànxí jiéshù hòu, fùzé zǔzhī de tóngshì yǒuxiē jiāolǜ: wǔtái bù dà, zhǔnbèi shíjiān yòu duǎn, dàjiā de chéngdù yǒu zhème dà de chābié, zuìhòu néng chàng hǎo ma?
paragraphs.translation: The neighborhood is preparing to organize a choral concert for a holiday and invites residents to sign up. Almost as soon as the notice is posted, registrations exceed the expected number. Some took part in singing and dancing performances when they were young; others cannot sing even simple songs in tune. There are also some elderly people with hearing difficulties who always need to stand a little closer to the teacher. At the end of the first rehearsal, the colleague in charge of organizing it is a little anxious: the stage is small, preparation time is short, and abilities vary so much—will they manage to sing well in the end?

paragraphs.hanzi: 一位有经验的老师建议，先不要急着挑选最好的声音，而要听清每个人能做什么。她把一首歌分成几部分，让大家一个接一个地试着唱，又请会弹琴的居民帮助伴奏。年轻人记得快，而老人则更了解歌词中的情感，常能讲出一些令人回味的往事。原来被当成问题的差别，也可以成为互补的条件。练习室里慢慢有了交谈，不再只有老师的要求。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yī wèi yǒu jīngyàn de lǎoshī jiànyì, xiān bù yào jí zhe tiāoxuǎn zuì hǎo de shēngyīn, ér yào tīng qīng měi ge rén néng zuò shénme. Tā bǎ yī shǒu gē fēn chéng jǐ bùfen, ràng dàjiā yī ge jiē yī ge de shì zhe chàng, yòu qǐng huì tán qín de jūmín bāngzhù bànzòu. Niánqīngrén jì de kuài, ér lǎorén zé gèng liǎojiě gēcí zhōng de qínggǎn, cháng néng jiǎng chū yīxiē lìng rén huíwèi de wǎngshì. Yuánlái bèi dàngchéng wèntí de chābié, yě kěyǐ chéngwéi hùbǔ de tiáojiàn. Liànxíshì lǐ mànmàn yǒu le jiāotán, bù zài zhǐ yǒu lǎoshī de yāoqiú.
paragraphs.translation: An experienced teacher suggests not rushing to select the best voices, but listening carefully to what each person can do. She divides a song into several parts and has everyone try singing, one after another; she also asks residents who play instruments to help with the accompaniment. The younger people memorize quickly, while the older people understand the feelings expressed in the lyrics better and can often share memories worth dwelling on. The differences initially seen as a problem can also allow people to complement one another. Gradually, conversations begin in the rehearsal room: it is no longer just the teacher giving instructions.

paragraphs.hanzi: 不过，一次练习中，还是有人提出，把跟不上节奏的人安排到后面，声音小一点，演出的效果就能好一些。一位老人没有争吵，只问：如果唱得不准就不能唱，我们为什么还要来？这句话让房间安静下来。老师说，与其让少数人完成一场漂亮的表演，不如让所有参加的人真正学会一起唱。她调整了几个地方，宁愿少唱一首，也不让谁只是站在台上做样子。
paragraphs.pinyin: Bùguò, yī cì liànxí zhōng, hái shì yǒu rén tíchū, bǎ gēn bù shàng jiézòu de rén ānpái dào hòumiàn, shēngyīn xiǎo yīdiǎn, yǎnchū de xiàoguǒ jiù néng hǎo yīxiē. Yī wèi lǎorén méiyǒu zhēngchǎo, zhǐ wèn: rúguǒ chàng de bù zhǔn jiù bù néng chàng, wǒmen wèishénme hái yào lái? Zhè jù huà ràng fángjiān ānjìng xiàlái. Lǎoshī shuō, yǔqí ràng shǎoshù rén wánchéng yī chǎng piàoliang de biǎoyǎn, bùrú ràng suǒyǒu cānjiā de rén zhēnzhèng xuéhuì yīqǐ chàng. Tā tiáozhěng le jǐ ge dìfang, nìngyuàn shǎo chàng yī shǒu, yě bù ràng shéi zhǐshì zhàn zài tái shàng zuò yàngzi.
paragraphs.translation: During one rehearsal, however, someone again proposes putting those who cannot keep time at the back and having them sing more quietly to improve the performance. An elderly man does not start an argument, but simply asks: if those who sing out of tune cannot sing, why should we keep coming? His words bring silence to the room. The teacher says that rather than having a few people put on a fine performance, it is better for all the participants to truly learn to sing together. She changes several passages: she would rather perform one fewer song than leave someone onstage merely to make up the numbers.

paragraphs.hanzi: 演出那天，开始时仍有一点混乱，后来大家互相看着，终于找到了共同的节奏。台下的喝彩并不意味着每个声音都完美。对我们来说，更重要的是，那些曾经害羞、不敢唱的人也抬起了头。演出结束后，居民们没有马上离开，而是商量下次练什么。一次节日活动，留下了继续见面的理由；合唱的意义，也不再只是一首歌的好坏。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yǎnchū nà tiān, kāishǐ shí réng yǒu yīdiǎn hùnluàn, hòulái dàjiā hùxiāng kàn zhe, zhōngyú zhǎodào le gòngtóng de jiézòu. Tái xià de hècǎi bìng bù yìwèi zhe měi ge shēngyīn dōu wánměi. Duì wǒmen lái shuō, gèng zhòngyào de shì, nàxiē céngjīng hàixiū, bù gǎn chàng de rén yě tái qǐ le tóu. Yǎnchū jiéshù hòu, jūmínmen méiyǒu mǎshàng líkāi, érshì shāngliang xià cì liàn shénme. Yī cì jiérì huódòng, liúxià le jìxù jiànmiàn de lǐyóu; héchàng de yìyì, yě bù zài zhǐshì yī shǒu gē de hǎohuài.
paragraphs.translation: On the day of the performance, there is still a little confusion at first; then, by watching one another, everyone finally finds a common rhythm. The audience's cheers do not mean that every voice is perfect. What matters more to us is that even the people who were previously shy and afraid to sing have lifted their heads. After the performance, the residents do not leave immediately, but discuss what to try next time. A holiday activity has given them a reason to keep meeting; the meaning of choral singing, too, is no longer limited to how well or badly a song is performed.

paragraphs.hanzi: 学校准备举办一场面向孩子的科普活动，我负责修改讲解材料。第一份稿子内容很完整，几乎涵盖了所有重要概念，读起来却十分枯燥。同事建议多放几张漂亮的图片，我觉得仅有图片还不够。孩子们之所以来这里，是因为他们对世界有许多真实的疑问；如果讲解只是让他们记住答案，那就错过了最有价值的部分。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhǔnbèi jǔbàn yī chǎng miànxiàng háizi de kēpǔ huódòng, wǒ fùzé xiūgǎi jiǎngjiě cáiliào. Dì yī fèn gǎozi nèiróng hěn wánzhěng, jīhū hángài le suǒyǒu zhòngyào gàiniàn, dú qǐlái què shífēn kūzào. Tóngshì jiànyì duō fàng jǐ zhāng piàoliang de túpiàn, wǒ juéde jǐn yǒu túpiàn hái bù gòu. Háizimen zhī suǒyǐ lái zhèlǐ, shì yīnwèi tāmen duì shìjiè yǒu xǔduō zhēnshí de yíwèn; rúguǒ jiǎngjiě zhǐshì ràng tāmen jìzhù dá'àn, nà jiù cuòguò le zuì yǒu jiàzhí de bùfen.
paragraphs.translation: The school is preparing to organize a science outreach activity for children, and I am responsible for revising the explanatory materials. The first draft is very comprehensive and covers almost all the important concepts, but it is extremely dry to read. A colleague suggests adding some attractive pictures; I think pictures alone are not enough. Children come here because they have many genuine questions about the world: if explanations serve only to make them memorize answers, the most valuable part is lost.

paragraphs.hanzi: 我们借助一次小范围的活动试着了解孩子的想法。讲到星星时，一个孩子问，为什么白天看不见它们？我刚开始解释，另一个孩子就举起手，说可能是星星白天都睡觉了。有人笑了，我却请他说说理由。他认真指出，自己睡觉时也会把灯关掉。这当然不能当作科学解释，但它让我们看见了孩子如何用熟悉的经验理解不熟悉的事物。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒmen jièzhù yī cì xiǎo fànwéi de huódòng shì zhe liǎojiě háizi de xiǎngfǎ. Jiǎng dào xīngxing shí, yī ge háizi wèn, wèishénme báitiān kàn bù jiàn tāmen? Wǒ gāng kāishǐ jiěshì, lìng yī ge háizi jiù jǔ qǐ shǒu, shuō kěnéng shì xīngxing báitiān dōu shuìjiào le. Yǒu rén xiào le, wǒ què qǐng tā shuōshuo lǐyóu. Tā rènzhēn zhǐchū, zìjǐ shuìjiào shí yě huì bǎ dēng guāndiào. Zhè dāngrán bù néng dàngzuò kēxué jiěshì, dàn tā ràng wǒmen kànjiàn le háizi rúhé yòng shúxī de jīngyàn lǐjiě bù shúxī de shìwù.
paragraphs.translation: Through a small-scale activity, we try to understand how children think. When we talk about the stars, one child asks why they cannot be seen during the day. I have barely begun explaining when another raises his hand and says that perhaps all the stars sleep during the day. Someone laughs, but I invite him to explain why. He points out seriously that he, too, turns off the light when he goes to sleep. Of course, this cannot be considered a scientific explanation, but it shows us how children use familiar experiences to understand things they do not know.

paragraphs.hanzi: 修改后的活动不再一开始就列出概念，而是先请大家说出猜想，再一起讨论有什么办法可以检验。我们把灯光调暗，让孩子比较不同条件下能看到什么，并明确说明，这个活动只是帮助理解，不能替代真实的观测。精确固然重要，但是把每个细节都塞进一次讲解，也可能使主要问题变得不清楚。我们精简了材料，留下更多提问的时间，以免孩子只顾抄写，没有机会思考。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xiūgǎi hòu de huódòng bù zài yī kāishǐ jiù liè chū gàiniàn, érshì xiān qǐng dàjiā shuō chū cāixiǎng, zài yīqǐ tǎolùn yǒu shénme bànfǎ kěyǐ jiǎnyàn. Wǒmen bǎ dēngguāng tiáo àn, ràng háizi bǐjiào bù tóng tiáojiàn xià néng kàn dào shénme, bìng míngquè shuōmíng, zhège huódòng zhǐshì bāngzhù lǐjiě, bù néng tìdài zhēnshí de guāncè. Jīngquè gùrán zhòngyào, dànshì bǎ měi ge xìjié dōu sāi jìn yī cì jiǎngjiě, yě kěnéng shǐ zhǔyào wèntí biàn de bù qīngchu. Wǒmen jīngjiǎn le cáiliào, liúxià gèng duō tíwèn de shíjiān, yǐmiǎn háizi zhǐgù chāoxiě, méiyǒu jīhuì sīkǎo.
paragraphs.translation: The revised activity no longer begins with a list of concepts: first we invite everyone to suggest hypotheses, then we discuss together how to test them. We dim the light and have the children compare what they can see under different conditions, making clear that the activity is only intended to aid understanding and cannot replace actual observation. Accuracy certainly matters, but cramming every detail into a single explanation can also obscure the main issue. We streamline the materials and leave more time for questions, so that children do not simply copy things down without a chance to think.

paragraphs.hanzi: 正式活动结束时，仍有几个问题没有得到回答。我本来担心这会让家长失望，却有人说，孩子回家后还想继续找资料。这让我很受鼓舞。即便一场活动不能解决全部疑问，也可以成为下一次探索的开始。好的科普不必把讲解者变成什么都知道的人，而应当让听众知道，面对不懂的事情，可以如何谨慎地提出问题、寻找证据，并调整自己的理解。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhèngshì huódòng jiéshù shí, réng yǒu jǐ ge wèntí méiyǒu dédào huídá. Wǒ běnlái dānxīn zhè huì ràng jiāzhǎng shīwàng, què yǒu rén shuō, háizi huí jiā hòu hái xiǎng jìxù zhǎo zīliào. Zhè ràng wǒ hěn shòu gǔwǔ. Jíbiàn yī chǎng huódòng bù néng jiějué quánbù yíwèn, yě kěyǐ chéngwéi xià yī cì tànsuǒ de kāishǐ. Hǎo de kēpǔ bù bì bǎ jiǎngjiě zhě biàn chéng shénme dōu zhīdào de rén, ér yīngdāng ràng tīngzhòng zhīdào, miànduì bù dǒng de shìqing, kěyǐ rúhé jǐnshèn de tíchū wèntí, xúnzhǎo zhèngjù, bìng tiáozhěng zìjǐ de lǐjiě.
paragraphs.translation: When the main activity ends, some questions remain unanswered. At first, I worry that the parents will be disappointed, but one says that their child still wants to look for information after going home. This encourages me greatly. Even if one session cannot resolve every uncertainty, it can become the beginning of a new exploration. Good science communication should not turn the person explaining into someone who knows everything: instead, it should show the audience how, when faced with something they do not understand, they can formulate questions cautiously, seek evidence, and revise their understanding.

paragraphs.hanzi: 工厂决定调整夜间的轮班安排时，我是最先赞成的人之一。新方案把几项工作集中到一起，可以减少机器停下来的次数，降低能耗。负责计算的同事列出了详细的数字，大家都觉得很有道理。直到一位工人提出，他下班后要照顾年迈的母亲，时间一改就赶不上早上的公共汽车，我才意识到，表格之外还有我们没有看到的生活。
paragraphs.pinyin: Gōngchǎng juédìng tiáozhěng yèjiān de lúnbān ānpái shí, wǒ shì zuì xiān zànchéng de rén zhī yī. Xīn fāng'àn bǎ jǐ xiàng gōngzuò jízhōng dào yīqǐ, kěyǐ jiǎnshǎo jīqì tíng xiàlái de cìshù, jiàngdī nénghào. Fùzé jìsuàn de tóngshì liè chū le xiángxì de shùzì, dàjiā dōu juéde hěn yǒu dàoli. Zhídào yī wèi gōngrén tíchū, tā xiàbān hòu yào zhàogu niánmài de mǔqīn, shíjiān yī gǎi jiù gǎn bù shàng zǎoshang de gōnggòngqìchē, wǒ cái yìshí dào, biǎogé zhī wài hái yǒu wǒmen méiyǒu kàn dào de shēnghuó.
paragraphs.translation: When the factory decides to change the organization of night shifts, I am among the first to support it. The new plan combines some operations, reducing machine downtime and energy consumption. The colleague responsible for the calculations presents detailed figures, and everyone finds them very convincing. Only when a worker points out that he has to care for his elderly mother after work and that the changed hours will mean he can no longer catch the morning bus do I realize that beyond the tables of figures are lives we have failed to see.

paragraphs.hanzi: 会上有人说，方案已经讨论了很久，不能因为一个人的难处再改变。另一位同事反问，难道只有写进表格的成本才算成本吗？争论越来越激烈，大家改了又算，算了又改，却始终找不到满意的结果。对我来说，坚持也不是，不坚持也不是：既不想放弃已经发现的改进机会，也不愿把不方便全部交给别人承担。我们决定暂停表决，先分别听听各组的意见。
paragraphs.pinyin: Huì shàng yǒu rén shuō, fāng'àn yǐjīng tǎolùn le hěn jiǔ, bù néng yīnwèi yī ge rén de nánchu zài gǎibiàn. Lìng yī wèi tóngshì fǎnwèn, nándào zhǐ yǒu xiě jìn biǎogé de chéngběn cái suàn chéngběn ma? Zhēnglùn yuè lái yuè jīliè, dàjiā gǎi le yòu suàn, suàn le yòu gǎi, què shǐzhōng zhǎo bù dào mǎnyì de jiéguǒ. Duì wǒ lái shuō, jiānchí yě bù shì, bù jiānchí yě bù shì: jì bù xiǎng fàngqì yǐjīng fāxiàn de gǎijìn jīhuì, yě bù yuàn bǎ bù fāngbiàn quánbù jiāo gěi biérén chéngdān. Wǒmen juédìng zàntíng biǎojué, xiān fēnbié tīngting gè zǔ de yìjiàn.
paragraphs.translation: At the meeting, someone says that the plan has been discussed at length and cannot be changed again because of one person's difficulties. Another colleague counters with a question: do only the costs written in the tables count? The discussion grows increasingly heated; everyone revises and recalculates, recalculates and revises, without ever finding a satisfactory result. For me, it is a dilemma: neither insisting nor giving up feels right. I do not want to lose the opportunities for improvement we have already identified, nor leave others to bear the entire burden of the inconvenience. We decide to postpone the vote and first listen separately to the views of each group.

paragraphs.hanzi: 接下来的几天，我们记录不同岗位实际需要的时间，也让工人匿名写下自己的顾虑。有人担心路途不安全，有人希望保留原来的休息安排，还有人愿意换班，只是从来没有被问过。原来，困难并不像会上呈现的那样只有一种。我们不再要求所有岗位同时改变，而是让一部分人先试一段时间，并安排轮换，给那些确实有困难的人留下选择。
paragraphs.pinyin: Jiēxiàlái de jǐ tiān, wǒmen jìlù bù tóng gǎngwèi shíjì xūyào de shíjiān, yě ràng gōngrén nìmíng xiě xià zìjǐ de gùlǜ. Yǒu rén dānxīn lùtú bù ānquán, yǒu rén xīwàng bǎoliú yuánlái de xiūxi ānpái, hái yǒu rén yuànyì huàn bān, zhǐshì cónglái méiyǒu bèi wèn guo. Yuánlái, kùnnan bìng bù xiàng huì shàng chéngxiàn de nàyàng zhǐ yǒu yī zhǒng. Wǒmen bù zài yāoqiú suǒyǒu gǎngwèi tóngshí gǎibiàn, érshì ràng yī bùfen rén xiān shì yī duàn shíjiān, bìng ānpái lúnhuàn, gěi nàxiē quèshí yǒu kùnnan de rén liúxià xuǎnzé.
paragraphs.translation: Over the next few days, we record the time actually needed for different tasks and invite workers to write down their concerns anonymously. Some worry that the commute will be unsafe; others hope to retain their current rest arrangements. Still others are willing to change shifts, but no one had ever asked them. We thus discover that the difficulties are not all of one kind, as they seemed to be at the meeting. We no longer require all workstations to change simultaneously: we have some of the staff try the arrangement for a period first and organize a rotation, leaving those with genuine difficulties some choice.

paragraphs.hanzi: 一个月后，新安排节省的能源没有最初估算的那么多，但工作中的忙乱减少了，请假也少了。话是这么说，方案仍不能让每个人都满意，后续还需要继续调整。不过，我们学到了一件重要的事：提高效率，不应只比较机器运行的情况，还要看人的疲劳是否增加、承诺能否履行。真正可行的安排，是让提出问题的人有机会参与解决，而不是让他们默默承受。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yī ge yuè hòu, xīn ānpái jiéshěng de néngyuán méiyǒu zuìchū gūsuàn de nàme duō, dàn gōngzuò zhōng de mángluàn jiǎnshǎo le, qǐngjià yě shǎo le. Huà shì zhème shuō, fāng'àn réng bù néng ràng měi ge rén dōu mǎnyì, hòuxù hái xūyào jìxù tiáozhěng. Bùguò, wǒmen xuédào le yī jiàn zhòngyào de shì: tígāo xiàolǜ, bù yīng zhǐ bǐjiào jīqì yùnxíng de qíngkuàng, hái yào kàn rén de píláo shìfǒu zēngjiā, chéngnuò néngfǒu lǚxíng. Zhēnzhèng kěxíng de ānpái, shì ràng tíchū wèntí de rén yǒu jīhuì cānyù jiějué, ér bù shì ràng tāmen mòmò chéngshòu.
paragraphs.translation: A month later, the energy savings from the new arrangement are lower than the initial estimate, but there is less confusion at work and fewer requests for leave. That said, the plan still cannot satisfy everyone and will need further adjustments. Yet we have learned something important: improving efficiency requires more than comparing how machines operate; we must also see whether people are becoming more tired and whether their commitments can be met. A truly workable arrangement gives those who raise a problem the opportunity to take part in solving it, rather than forcing them to endure it in silence.

title: The Sound That Would Not Be Archived

paragraphs.hanzi: 我们准备为当地的传统手艺建立一个数据库，第一站是一位制作木偶的师傅。出发前，大家已经列好清单：拍摄工具、记录工序、扫描旧照片，再把资料按类别整理。我们以为，只要设备够好，失传的风险就能轻而易举地消除。师傅却没有立即开始示范。他问，把一个动作拍下来，是否就意味着另一个人真正学会了？这个问题使我们重新审视原来的计划。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒmen zhǔnbèi wèi dāngdì de chuántǒng shǒuyì jiànlì yī ge shùjùkù, dì yī zhàn shì yī wèi zhìzuò mù'ǒu de shīfu. Chūfā qián, dàjiā yǐjīng liè hǎo qīngdān: pāishè gōngjù, jìlù gōngxù, sǎomiáo jiù zhàopiàn, zài bǎ zīliào àn lèibié zhěnglǐ. Wǒmen yǐwéi, zhǐyào shèbèi gòu hǎo, shīchuán de fēngxiǎn jiù néng qīng'éryìjǔ de xiāochú. Shīfu què méiyǒu lìjí kāishǐ shìfàn. Tā wèn, bǎ yī ge dòngzuò pāi xiàlái, shìfǒu jiù yìwèi zhe lìng yī ge rén zhēnzhèng xuéhuì le? Zhège wèntí shǐ wǒmen chóngxīn shěnshì yuánlái de jìhuà.
paragraphs.translation: We are preparing to create a database of the area's traditional crafts. Our first stop is a master craftsman who makes marionettes. Before setting out, we have already compiled a list: film the tools, record the production stages, scan the old photographs, and then organize the materials by category. We think that with equipment good enough, we can easily eliminate the risk of this knowledge being lost. The master, however, does not immediately begin his demonstration. He asks: does filming a movement mean that someone else has truly learned it? This question makes us reconsider our original plan.

paragraphs.hanzi: 师傅先拿出一件还没有完成的作品，让我们听工具切过木材时发出的声音。他说，遇到不同的材料，手上的力量必须改变；有些区别极为重要，只看画面却很难识别。随后，他请我们亲手试做。我照着视频中的角度操作，结果差一点毁坏作品。师傅及时劝阻，又让我放慢动作，注意手指感到的变化。我才明白，视频可以保存过程，却未必能保存全部经验。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shīfu xiān ná chū yī jiàn hái méiyǒu wánchéng de zuòpǐn, ràng wǒmen tīng gōngjù qiē guò mùcái shí fā chū de shēngyīn. Tā shuō, yùdào bù tóng de cáiliào, shǒu shàng de lìliang bìxū gǎibiàn; yǒuxiē qūbié jíwéi zhòngyào, zhǐ kàn huàmiàn què hěn nán shíbié. Suíhòu, tā qǐng wǒmen qīnshǒu shì zuò. Wǒ zhào zhe shìpín zhōng de jiǎodù cāozuò, jiéguǒ chà yīdiǎn huǐhuài zuòpǐn. Shīfu jíshí quànzǔ, yòu ràng wǒ fàng màn dòngzuò, zhùyì shǒuzhǐ gǎndào de biànhuà. Wǒ cái míngbai, shìpín kěyǐ bǎocún guòchéng, què wèibì néng bǎocún quánbù jīngyàn.
paragraphs.translation: First, the master brings out an unfinished piece and has us listen to the sound the tool makes as it cuts the wood. He says that the pressure exerted by the hand must change with different materials; some differences are extremely important, but difficult to recognize just by watching images. Then he invites us to try for ourselves. I work at the angle shown in the video and nearly ruin the piece. The master stops me in time, then has me slow my movements and pay attention to the changes I feel through my fingers. Only then do I understand that a video can preserve the procedure, but not necessarily the full experience.

paragraphs.hanzi: 此后，我们把记录的重点稍稍调整，不只拍摄成功的步骤，也请师傅讲述失误和判断的依据。遇到不能确定的说法，就在资料中如实说明，再请其他从业者帮助求证。师傅尤其关心资料的去向：公开之后，别人会不会擅自拿去出售？我们同他一起商讨授权的范围，保留需要进一步讨论的部分，而不是把公开当成唯一正确的选择。
paragraphs.pinyin: Cǐhòu, wǒmen bǎ jìlù de zhòngdiǎn shāoshāo tiáozhěng, bù zhǐ pāishè chénggōng de bùzhòu, yě qǐng shīfu jiǎngshù shīwù hé pànduàn de yījù. Yùdào bù néng quèdìng de shuōfǎ, jiù zài zīliào zhōng rúshí shuōmíng, zài qǐng qítā cóngyèzhě bāngzhù qiúzhèng. Shīfu yóuqí guānxīn zīliào de qùxiàng: gōngkāi zhī hòu, biérén huì bù huì shànzì ná qù chūshòu? Wǒmen tóng tā yīqǐ shāngtǎo shòuquán de fànwéi, bǎoliú xūyào jìn yī bù tǎolùn de bùfen, ér bù shì bǎ gōngkāi dàngchéng wéiyī zhèngquè de xuǎnzé.
paragraphs.translation: From then on, we adjust the focus of our documentation slightly: we do not just film successful steps, but also ask the master to describe mistakes and the reasoning behind his judgments. When we encounter an uncertain statement, we faithfully indicate this in the materials and ask other practitioners to help us verify it. The master's greatest concern is how the materials will be used: once published, could someone take them and sell them without permission? We discuss the scope of permissions with him and leave pending any sections that require further discussion, rather than treating publication as the only right choice.

paragraphs.hanzi: 几个月后，数据库终于可以使用了，但我们没有把它称作完整的传承。它更像一道入口，让有兴趣的人找到学习的机会，也让手艺人的权益受到尊重。一位学生看过资料后，来找师傅请教，愿意从最普通的准备工作学起。师傅听完笑了。这一次，他没有先问设备带齐没有，而是搬来一把椅子，让学生坐到自己身边，认真听那段清脆的声音。
paragraphs.pinyin: Jǐ ge yuè hòu, shùjùkù zhōngyú kěyǐ shǐyòng le, dàn wǒmen méiyǒu bǎ tā chēngzuò wánzhěng de chuánchéng. Tā gèng xiàng yī dào rùkǒu, ràng yǒu xìngqù de rén zhǎodào xuéxí de jīhuì, yě ràng shǒuyìrén de quányì shòudào zūnzhòng. Yī wèi xuésheng kàn guo zīliào hòu, lái zhǎo shīfu qǐngjiào, yuànyì cóng zuì pǔtōng de zhǔnbèi gōngzuò xué qǐ. Shīfu tīng wán xiào le. Zhè yī cì, tā méiyǒu xiān wèn shèbèi dài qí méiyǒu, érshì bān lái yī bǎ yǐzi, ràng xuésheng zuò dào zìjǐ shēnbiān, rènzhēn tīng nà duàn qīngcuì de shēngyīn.
paragraphs.translation: A few months later, the database is finally ready to use, but we do not call it a complete transmission of knowledge. It is more of a gateway, enabling interested people to find learning opportunities and protecting the rights and interests of craftspeople. After consulting the materials, a student comes to ask the master for instruction, willing to begin with the most routine preparations. The master listens and smiles. This time, his first question is not whether the student has brought all the equipment: instead, he pulls up a chair, seats the student beside him, and has him listen carefully to that clear sound.

paragraphs.hanzi: 城市的一条老街即将改造，设计人员带着图纸来听居民的意见。图上道路通畅，停车位整齐，几处空地也安排得很妥当。然而，一位每天步行买菜的老人看了很久，问为什么没有可以坐下来的地方。设计人员解释，附近已有一个广场。老人摇头：广场不远，可是提着东西走过去，与什么都不拿就走过去，是完全不同的感觉。
paragraphs.pinyin: Chéngshì de yī tiáo lǎo jiē jíjiāng gǎizào, shèjì rényuán dài zhe túzhǐ lái tīng jūmín de yìjiàn. Tú shàng dàolù tōngchàng, tíngchēwèi zhěngqí, jǐ chù kòngdì yě ānpái de hěn tuǒdang. Rán'ér, yī wèi měitiān bùxíng mǎi cài de lǎorén kàn le hěn jiǔ, wèn wèishénme méiyǒu kěyǐ zuò xiàlái de dìfang. Shèjì rényuán jiěshì, fùjìn yǐ yǒu yī ge guǎngchǎng. Lǎorén yáotóu: guǎngchǎng bù yuǎn, kěshì tí zhe dōngxi zǒu guòqù, yǔ shénme dōu bù ná jiù zǒu guòqù, shì wánquán bù tóng de gǎnjué.
paragraphs.translation: An old city street is about to be renovated, and the designers arrive with their plans to hear the residents' views. On paper, traffic flows smoothly, parking spaces are orderly, and several open spaces are also appropriately arranged. But an elderly man who walks to buy vegetables every day studies the drawing for a long time and asks why there is nowhere to sit. The designers explain that there is already a square nearby. The elderly man shakes his head: the square is not far away, but getting there carrying heavy bags is a completely different experience from walking empty-handed.

paragraphs.hanzi: 为了弄清这种差别，我们邀请几位居民带路，沿着他们平时的路线走一遍。有人需要绕开损坏的路面，有人要在商店门口等同伴，还有人走到半路就感到疲倦。图纸上微不足道的距离，在真实生活中却与年龄、体能和随身带的东西息息相关。与此同时，我们也发现，一些看似没有用途的角落，实际上是居民每天交谈、互相照应的地方。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wèile nòng qīng zhè zhǒng chābié, wǒmen yāoqǐng jǐ wèi jūmín dàilù, yán zhe tāmen píngshí de lùxiàn zǒu yī biàn. Yǒu rén xūyào rào kāi sǔnhuài de lùmiàn, yǒu rén yào zài shāngdiàn ménkǒu děng tóngbàn, hái yǒu rén zǒu dào bànlù jiù gǎndào píjuàn. Túzhǐ shàng wēibùzúdào de jùlí, zài zhēnshí shēnghuó zhōng què yǔ niánlíng, tǐnéng hé suíshēn dài de dōngxi xīxīxiāngguān. Yǔ cǐ tóngshí, wǒmen yě fāxiàn, yīxiē kàn sì méiyǒu yòngtú de jiǎoluò, shíjì shàng shì jūmín měitiān jiāotán, hùxiāng zhàoying de dìfang.
paragraphs.translation: To understand this difference, we invite some residents to guide us along their usual routes. Some have to go around sections of damaged pavement, some wait for a companion outside a shop, and others feel tired halfway there. Distances that seem negligible on the plan are, in real life, closely linked to age, fitness, and what people are carrying. At the same time, we discover that some seemingly useless corners are actually places where residents chat every day and look after one another.

paragraphs.hanzi: 新的讨论不再只围绕车道的宽度。居民提出，能否保留树荫，增加通风的休息空间，让行人不必绕太远。商店的经营者担心失去门前的位置，设计人员便把几种方案画在一起，说明各自的得失。没有谁的要求被统统接受，也没有谁因不懂专业知识而被排除。经过几次调整，大家同意先改一小段，使用之后再根据反馈继续完善。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xīn de tǎolùn bù zài zhǐ wéirào chēdào de kuāndù. Jūmín tíchū, néngfǒu bǎoliú shùyīn, zēngjiā tōngfēng de xiūxi kōngjiān, ràng xíngrén bù bì rào tài yuǎn. Shāngdiàn de jīngyíngzhě dānxīn shīqù mén qián de wèizhi, shèjì rényuán biàn bǎ jǐ zhǒng fāng'àn huà zài yīqǐ, shuōmíng gèzì de déshī. Méiyǒu shéi de yāoqiú bèi tǒngtǒng jiēshòu, yě méiyǒu shéi yīn bù dǒng zhuānyè zhīshi ér bèi páichú. Jīngguò jǐ cì tiáozhěng, dàjiā tóngyì xiān gǎi yī xiǎo duàn, shǐyòng zhī hòu zài gēnjù fǎnkuì jìxù wánshàn.
paragraphs.translation: The new discussion is no longer just about the width of traffic lanes. Residents ask whether the shade of the trees can be preserved and well-ventilated resting areas added, without making pedestrians take long detours. Shopkeepers worry about losing the space in front of their shops; the designers then work together to draw up several options and explain their advantages and disadvantages. No one has all their requests met, but no one is excluded for lacking technical knowledge. After several revisions, everyone agrees to renovate a short section first and keep improving it based on feedback once it is in use.

paragraphs.hanzi: 改造完成的第一个下午，那位老人坐在路旁的新椅子上，跟熟人聊起过去的街道。旁边没有特别引人注意的牌子，只有一处能让人停顿的地方。这样一来，本来匆匆经过的人也愿意多留一会儿。总的来说，这次改造最重要的变化，并不是图纸比以前漂亮，而是我们学会了换一种尺度看城市：不只看车辆能否顺利通过，也看每个普通人能否从容地走完自己的日常路线。
paragraphs.pinyin: Gǎizào wánchéng de dì yī ge xiàwǔ, nà wèi lǎorén zuò zài lù páng de xīn yǐzi shàng, gēn shúrén liáo qǐ guòqù de jiēdào. Pángbiān méiyǒu tèbié yǐn rén zhùyì de páizi, zhǐ yǒu yī chù néng ràng rén tíngdùn de dìfang. Zhèyàng yī lái, běnlái cōngcōng jīngguò de rén yě yuànyì duō liú yīhuìr. Zǒng de lái shuō, zhè cì gǎizào zuì zhòngyào de biànhuà, bìng bù shì túzhǐ bǐ yǐqián piàoliang, érshì wǒmen xuéhuì le huàn yī zhǒng chǐdù kàn chéngshì: bù zhǐ kàn chēliàng néngfǒu shùnlì tōngguò, yě kàn měi ge pǔtōngrén néngfǒu cóngróng de zǒu wán zìjǐ de rìcháng lùxiàn.
paragraphs.translation: On the first afternoon after the work is completed, the elderly man sits on the new roadside bench and chats with acquaintances about what the street used to be like. There are no particularly eye-catching signs beside it, just a place where people can stop. As a result, even those who used to hurry past are willing to linger a little longer. Overall, the most important change brought by this renovation is not that the drawings look better than before: we have learned to view the city by a different measure, considering not only whether vehicles can pass easily, but also whether every ordinary person can make their daily journeys at an unhurried pace.

title: When a News Report Seems True

paragraphs.hanzi: 一天早上，家里的群里出现一条消息，说附近的饮用水可能受到污染，最好马上停止使用。消息附着一张图片，几个醒目的字让人十分不安。母亲准备把它转给邻居，我却发现图片没有写清时间，所谓专家的身份也很含糊。按说，提醒别人注意安全是好事，可是信息不完整的时候，越急着传播，越可能引发不必要的恐慌。
paragraphs.pinyin: Yī tiān zǎoshang, jiā lǐ de qún lǐ chūxiàn yī tiáo xiāoxi, shuō fùjìn de yǐnyòngshuǐ kěnéng shòudào wūrǎn, zuì hǎo mǎshàng tíngzhǐ shǐyòng. Xiāoxi fù zhe yī zhāng túpiàn, jǐ ge xǐngmù de zì ràng rén shífēn bù'ān. Mǔqīn zhǔnbèi bǎ tā zhuǎn gěi línjū, wǒ què fāxiàn túpiàn méiyǒu xiě qīng shíjiān, suǒwèi zhuānjiā de shēnfèn yě hěn hánhu. Ànshuō, tíxǐng biérén zhùyì ānquán shì hǎoshì, kěshì xìnxī bù wánzhěng de shíhou, yuè jí zhe chuánbō, yuè kěnéng yǐnfā bù bìyào de kǒnghuāng.
paragraphs.translation: One morning, a message appears in the family group chat claiming that the local drinking water may be contaminated and that it would be best to stop using it immediately. Attached to the message is an image with some very prominent words that cause considerable alarm. My mother is about to forward it to the neighbors, but I notice that the image does not clearly indicate a date and that the identity of the supposed expert is also very vague. In principle, reminding others to take care over safety is a good thing; when information is incomplete, however, the more hurriedly we spread it, the greater the risk of causing unnecessary panic.

paragraphs.hanzi: 我没有当着大家的面指责母亲，而是和她一起寻找原来的报道。我们先看发布消息的地方，再找有没有其他资料可以印证。经过比较，才知道图片来自几年前的一次事故，地点也不是我们所在的城市。有人删除了原来的说明，又加上了眼下的地名。文字看似具体，实际上已经把几个不同的事实拼到了一起，构成了一个容易使人误解的故事。
paragraphs.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu dāng zhe dàjiā de miàn zhǐzé mǔqīn, érshì hé tā yīqǐ xúnzhǎo yuánlái de bàodào. Wǒmen xiān kàn fābù xiāoxi de dìfang, zài zhǎo yǒu méiyǒu qítā zīliào kěyǐ yìnzhèng. Jīngguò bǐjiào, cái zhīdào túpiàn láizì jǐ nián qián de yī cì shìgù, dìdiǎn yě bù shì wǒmen suǒ zài de chéngshì. Yǒu rén shānchú le yuánlái de shuōmíng, yòu jiā shàng le yǎnxià de dìmíng. Wénzì kàn sì jùtǐ, shíjì shàng yǐjīng bǎ jǐ ge bù tóng de shìshí pīn dào le yīqǐ, gòuchéng le yī ge róngyì shǐ rén wùjiě de gùshi.
paragraphs.translation: I do not scold my mother in front of everyone, but look for the original report with her. First we check where the message was published, then look for other material that could confirm it. Only after comparing sources do we discover that the image comes from an incident several years earlier, in a different city from ours. Someone has deleted the original explanation and added the name of the current location. The text seems precise, but in fact it has combined different facts to construct a story that can easily mislead.

paragraphs.hanzi: 母亲有些难为情，觉得自己太容易相信别人。我说，何必因为一次判断失误就否定自己呢？真正要紧的是，发现疑点之后能不能停下来求证。基于这次经历，我们约定，遇到与健康和安全有关的消息，不妨先检查来源、时间和证据，再决定是否转发。如果尚未查明，就如实说不知道，不用一个显而易见的答案填补所有空白。
paragraphs.pinyin: Mǔqīn yǒuxiē nánwéiqíng, juéde zìjǐ tài róngyì xiāngxìn biérén. Wǒ shuō, hébì yīnwèi yī cì pànduàn shīwù jiù fǒudìng zìjǐ ne? Zhēnzhèng yàojǐn de shì, fāxiàn yídiǎn zhī hòu néng bù néng tíng xiàlái qiúzhèng. Jīyú zhè cì jīnglì, wǒmen yuēdìng, yùdào yǔ jiànkāng hé ānquán yǒuguān de xiāoxi, bùfáng xiān jiǎnchá láiyuán, shíjiān hé zhèngjù, zài juédìng shìfǒu zhuǎnfā. Rúguǒ shàngwèi chámíng, jiù rúshí shuō bù zhīdào, bù yòng yī ge xiǎn'éryìjiàn de dá'àn tiánbǔ suǒyǒu kòngbái.
paragraphs.translation: My mother is a little embarrassed and thinks she trusts others too easily. I tell her: why put yourself down over one error of judgment? What really matters is being able to stop and check when doubts arise. Based on this experience, we agree that when news about health and safety arrives, it is best to check its source, date, and evidence first, and only then decide whether to forward it. If it has not yet been verified, we will honestly say we do not know, rather than filling every gap with a seemingly obvious answer.

paragraphs.hanzi: 后来，群里又有人发来类似的消息。这一次，母亲没有立即回应，而是问对方能不能提供完整的报道。对方开始有些不耐烦，最后还是找到了来源，并承认自己也没仔细看。一次小小的询问，没有使群里的关系变坏，反而让讨论变得严谨了一点。我想，识别虚假信息并不意味着怀疑每个人，而是对自己相信什么、向别人传递什么，多承担一份责任。
paragraphs.pinyin: Hòulái, qún lǐ yòu yǒu rén fā lái lèisì de xiāoxi. Zhè yī cì, mǔqīn méiyǒu lìjí huíyìng, érshì wèn duìfāng néng bù néng tígōng wánzhěng de bàodào. Duìfāng kāishǐ yǒuxiē bù nàifán, zuìhòu hái shì zhǎodào le láiyuán, bìng chéngrèn zìjǐ yě méi zǐxì kàn. Yī cì xiǎoxiǎo de xúnwèn, méiyǒu shǐ qún lǐ de guānxi biàn huài, fǎn'ér ràng tǎolùn biàn de yánjǐn le yīdiǎn. Wǒ xiǎng, shíbié xūjiǎ xìnxī bìng bù yìwèi zhe huáiyí měi ge rén, érshì duì zìjǐ xiāngxìn shénme, xiàng biérén chuándì shénme, duō chéngdān yī fèn zérèn.
paragraphs.translation: Later, someone sends a similar message to the group. This time, my mother does not react immediately, but asks the other person whether they can provide the full report. At first, the person is a little annoyed, but eventually finds the source and admits they had not read it carefully either. One small question has not damaged relationships in the group; on the contrary, it has made the discussion a little more rigorous. I think recognizing false information does not mean being suspicious of everyone, but taking greater responsibility for what we believe and what we pass on to others.

paragraphs.hanzi: 搬家时，我发现存放的东西比想象的多，其中还有一台坏了很久的收音机。它的外壳已经磨损，声音时有时无，家人都劝我干脆买新的。我原本也这样打算，却在整理旧照片时想起，父亲以前常用它听新闻。于是，我把它送到附近一家修理店。店主检查之后说，主要问题只是一个零件松了，并不是整台机器都失去了价值。
paragraphs.pinyin: Bānjiā shí, wǒ fāxiàn cúnfàng de dōngxi bǐ xiǎngxiàng de duō, qízhōng hái yǒu yī tái huài le hěn jiǔ de shōuyīnjī. Tā de wàiké yǐjīng mósǔn, shēngyīn shí yǒu shí wú, jiārén dōu quàn wǒ gāncuì mǎi xīn de. Wǒ yuánběn yě zhèyàng dǎsuàn, què zài zhěnglǐ jiù zhàopiàn shí xiǎng qǐ, fùqīn yǐqián cháng yòng tā tīng xīnwén. Yúshì, wǒ bǎ tā sòng dào fùjìn yī jiā xiūlǐdiàn. Diànzhǔ jiǎnchá zhī hòu shuō, zhǔyào wèntí zhǐshì yī ge língjiàn sōng le, bìng bù shì zhěng tái jīqì dōu shīqù le jiàzhí.
paragraphs.translation: While moving house, I discover that I have kept more things than I imagined, including a radio that has been broken for a long time. Its casing is already worn, the sound cuts in and out, and everyone in my family advises me simply to buy a new one. Initially, I intend to do just that, but while sorting through old photographs, I remember that my father often used it to listen to the news. So I take it to a nearby repair shop. After checking it, the owner says that the main problem is just a loose component: the whole device has not lost its value.

paragraphs.hanzi: 等待修理的时候，我看见店里摆着许多不同年代的东西。有些的确没有修好的可能，有些却只是因为主人不愿再等，就被留了下来。店主说，新的商品功能越来越多，价格也常常很诱人，可是人们不一定知道自己真正需要什么。听到这里，我不禁自责：我分明也没有认真检查过那台收音机，就先认定它应该被替换。
paragraphs.pinyin: Děngdài xiūlǐ de shíhou, wǒ kànjiàn diàn lǐ bǎi zhe xǔduō bù tóng niándài de dōngxi. Yǒuxiē díquè méiyǒu xiū hǎo de kěnéng, yǒuxiē què zhǐshì yīnwèi zhǔrén bù yuàn zài děng, jiù bèi liú le xiàlái. Diànzhǔ shuō, xīn de shāngpǐn gōngnéng yuè lái yuè duō, jiàgé yě chángcháng hěn yòurén, kěshì rénmen bù yīdìng zhīdào zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xūyào shénme. Tīng dào zhèlǐ, wǒ bùjīn zìzé: wǒ fēnmíng yě méiyǒu rènzhēn jiǎnchá guo nà tái shōuyīnjī, jiù xiān rèndìng tā yīnggāi bèi tìhuàn.
paragraphs.translation: While waiting for the repair, I see many objects from different periods in the shop. Some really are impossible to repair; others, however, were left there simply because their owners no longer wanted to wait. The shopkeeper says that new products have more and more features and often very attractive prices, but people do not necessarily know what they really need. Hearing this, I cannot help reproaching myself: clearly, I had not examined the radio carefully either, yet I had already decided it should be replaced.

paragraphs.hanzi: 不过，修理并非在任何情况下都更划算。我们算了材料、人工和运输的开支，也谈到老设备的能耗与安全。店主从不承诺所有东西都值得保留，他强调的是把理由说清楚，让选择有所依据。有的厂家不愿提供配件，维修的成本便会增加；有的产品设计得过于封闭，一个小问题也可能导致整件报废。这些障碍，不能只靠消费者的耐心克服。
paragraphs.pinyin: Bùguò, xiūlǐ bìngfēi zài rènhé qíngkuàng xià dōu gèng huásuàn. Wǒmen suàn le cáiliào, réngōng hé yùnshū de kāizhī, yě tán dào lǎo shèbèi de nénghào yǔ ānquán. Diànzhǔ cóng bù chéngnuò suǒyǒu dōngxi dōu zhíde bǎoliú, tā qiángdiào de shì bǎ lǐyóu shuō qīngchu, ràng xuǎnzé yǒu suǒ yījù. Yǒu de chǎngjiā bù yuàn tígōng pèijiàn, wéixiū de chéngběn biàn huì zēngjiā; yǒu de chǎnpǐn shèjì de guòyú fēngbì, yī ge xiǎo wèntí yě kěnéng dǎozhì zhěng jiàn bàofèi. Zhèxiē zhàng'ài, bù néng zhǐ kào xiāofèizhě de nàixīn kèfú.
paragraphs.translation: Repairing, however, is not more economical in every situation. We calculate the costs of materials, labor, and transport, and also discuss the energy consumption and safety of old appliances. The shopkeeper never promises that every object is worth keeping: he insists on the importance of clearly explaining the reasons so that the choice is well-founded. Some manufacturers refuse to supply spare parts, increasing repair costs; certain products are so sealed in their construction that even a minor problem can lead to the whole object being discarded. These obstacles cannot be overcome through consumers' patience alone.

paragraphs.hanzi: 几天后，收音机又响起熟悉的声音。我由衷地感谢店主，却没有把这件事当作拒绝所有新产品的理由。对我来说，它改变的是一种习惯：遇到损坏，先弄清原因，再决定修理、替换或回收。倘若只因为留下了旧东西，就觉得自己已经对环境尽到了责任，未免太简单了吧。真正有益的改变，还包括减少不必要的购买，珍视已有的东西，并支持让产品更容易维护的设计。
paragraphs.pinyin: Jǐ tiān hòu, shōuyīnjī yòu xiǎng qǐ shúxī de shēngyīn. Wǒ yóuzhōng de gǎnxiè diànzhǔ, què méiyǒu bǎ zhè jiàn shì dàngzuò jùjué suǒyǒu xīn chǎnpǐn de lǐyóu. Duì wǒ lái shuō, tā gǎibiàn de shì yī zhǒng xíguàn: yùdào sǔnhuài, xiān nòng qīng yuányīn, zài juédìng xiūlǐ, tìhuàn huò huíshōu. Tǎngruò zhǐ yīnwèi liúxià le jiù dōngxi, jiù juéde zìjǐ yǐjīng duì huánjìng jìn dào le zérèn, wèimiǎn tài jiǎndān le ba. Zhēnzhèng yǒuyì de gǎibiàn, hái bāokuò jiǎnshǎo bù bìyào de gòumǎi, zhēnshì yǐ yǒu de dōngxi, bìng zhīchí ràng chǎnpǐn gèng róngyì wéihù de shèjì.
paragraphs.translation: A few days later, the radio produces that familiar sound again. I thank the shopkeeper sincerely, but do not consider this experience a reason to reject all new products. For me, it has changed a habit: when something breaks, first establish the cause, then decide whether to repair, replace, or recycle it. Thinking that we have already fulfilled all our environmental responsibilities merely because we have kept an old object would be far too simplistic. Truly useful change also includes reducing unnecessary purchases, caring for what we already own, and supporting designs that make products easier to maintain.
